name: exhaust-order/juggernaut-from-feel-no-pain-kills-before-forgotten-soul
source: game: Hook.AfterCardExhausted via CombatState.IterateHookListeners (the owner's powers before its relics)
doc: FEEL_NO_PAIN_POWER's block sets off JUGGERNAUT_POWER first and its hit kills the lone enemy: the fight is ending, so FORGOTTEN_SOUL has no target and rolls nothing (one CombatTargets draw, JUGGERNAUT_POWER's). Run the other way round, FORGOTTEN_SOUL rolls first.

xfail_engines.old: old runs the relics' AfterCardExhausted before the owner's powers (hook_open: order play_effect AfterCardExhausted kind relic>power, fix/exhaust-listener-order 2fcefac9 not landed).
xfail_engines.core2: old runs the relics' AfterCardExhausted before the owner's powers (hook_open: order play_effect AfterCardExhausted kind relic>power, fix/exhaust-listener-order 2fcefac9 not landed); core2 runs old's rules until its family switch is on (migrated_families.json), so it fails the same way.
